title: Embed economics: bulk slab + floor pricing pilot and enterprise QSA flow
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: run a controlled pilot to test a bulk-slab pricing model for embeddings/rerank workloads that balances per-vector unit economics with predictable enterprise invoices and a minimum floor for low-volume high-value rerank calls. We need a clear QSA checklist and contract language for enterprise customers taking discounted slabs or committed volume.

Scope: define slab tiers (e.g., 0-1M vectors, 1M-10M, 10M+), a monthly committed credit option with overage rules, a per-batch meter for high-cardinality batched requests (how to translate batch -> vector units), and a floor/minimum billing clause for reranking endpoints to avoid price erosion for high-SLA, low-volume use cases. Produce pricing matrices, billing SKU mapping, contract term language, and a QSA package for sales/CS.

Success metrics: 1) pilot customers sign 3-month committed slab contracts (>= $20k ARR each), 2) measured reduction in average cost-per-vector by >=15% on batched workloads, 3) no open security/QSA blockers preventing contract close in pilot cohort.

Key open questions:
- How exactly do we convert a batched rerank request that calculates N embeddings and M comparison vectors into billable vector units? (propose: bill sum of produced vectors + deduped input vectors)
- Floor pricing for reranking: flat per-call minimum vs minimum monthly spend?
- Handling partial-month commitments and pro-rated credits.
- Billing SKU granularity for committed vs on-demand vs overage usage.

Deliverables: pricing sheet, PRD for billing/ingestion metering, QSA checklist & evidence pack, sample contract addendum, pilot measurement dashboard (cost, latency, token->vector conversion), internal playbook for sales and AMs.
comments: 2025-02-12 Aisha Kapoor: Initial PRD stub created. Added hypothesis and pilot success metrics. Tagged infra and legal for input on metering and contract language.
2025-02-14 Luca Moreno: Proposed slab tiers drafted and shared with Pricing Guild. Suggested a 6-tier slab to capture long-tail usage; asked Finance for margin model per slab.

2025-02-16 Legal (Nora Chen): Need explicit language for data handling in QSA for customers requesting on-prem or dedicated flows. Recommend encrypt-at-rest KMS clause and audit log evidence inclusion.
Action: legal will provide contract addendum template by 2025-02-21.

2025-02-17 Infra (Diego Han): Metering prototype PR submitted (link above). Prototype currently counts produced embeddings + unique input vectors per batch; does not dedupe across requests. Performance impact negligible in staging. Need confirmation on dedupe rule from PM.

2025-02-18 Sales (Maya Patel): Identified three pilot candidates (FinReg, SearchStack, LegalAssist). All ask for quarterly commitment option and explicit SLA credit terms. Also raised concern about billing transparency for customers that bundle embedding + rerank calls through a single route.

2025-02-19 Product Analytics (Evan Li): Built initial dashboard showing simulated billing under slab vs per-vector for 12 pilot customers. Early signal: batched workloads see 18% cost reduction under proposed slab tiers; but low-volume high-value rerank customers could pay less under on-demand unless minimum spend is enforced.

2025-02-20 Aisha Kapoor: Decision checkpoint: proceed with pilot using proposed slab tiers but enforce a monthly minimum invoice floor for rerank-capable endpoints (explicitly documented in contract addendum). Security review marked required. Next: finalize QSA evidence pack and instrument metering dedupe logic.
2025-02-20 Luca Moreno: Engineering estimate for full GA metering changes is 8 pts; proposed pilot uses opt-in metering toggle for pilot customers only to avoid platform-wide risk.
implementation_notes: Metering: bill = produced_embedding_count + unique_input_vectors_in_batch (dedupe within batch only). Engine team will add dedupe window config (default 0s) to allow experimentation.
Billing: new SKUs: EMB_SL1, EMB_SL2, EMB_SL3, EMB_COMMIT_OVR (overage). Map existing on-demand SKU to EMB_OD. Include 'rerank_endpoint_minimum' attribute for routes.
Contract: legal to add 'Committed Slab Addendum' with term, early termination, pro-rating, and KMS/data handling clauses. Include SOW example for pilot onboarding.
QSA: assemble encryption configuration screenshots, KMS policy evidence, network diagrams for VPC/dedicated deployments, and SOC2/ISO cert references.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Customers will be confused by batch->vector conversion rules. Mitigation: provide an online meter simulator and per-invoice line-item breakdown in console for pilot customers.
Risk: Enterprise QSA requests could slow closes. Mitigation: pre-build evidence pack and white-glove legal review for pilot cohort; prioritize customers with standard QSA needs.
Risk: Metering changes could regress latency. Mitigation: toggle for pilot that runs metering in async pipeline; ensure path guarded behind feature flag.
